meta.book_launch_title: The Layered Web: Community Review Draft and Governance Feedback Workflow

milestones.title: The Metaweb book
milestones.description: Publication of The Metaweb–a foundational narrative on the layered Web, collective intelligence, and the path toward a community-governed coordination layer.

milestones.title: Challenge kickoff
milestones.description: Internet pioneer Vint Cerf asked what desirable properties a new Coordination Layer above today's Web should possess–launching the Meta-Layer Initiative's global inquiry.

milestones.title: First Call for Input
milestones.description: Communities through People Centered Internet, Bridgit.io, and aligned partners submitted ideas, concerns, and aspirations for the future of the Internet.

milestones.title: Meta-Layer Initiative website
milestones.description: Launch of the public Meta-Layer Initiative site to broaden participation and surface the growing body of research and community work.

milestones.title: Second Call for Input
milestones.description: A broader public call gathered submissions from around the world. Contributions were preserved as Bitcoin Ordinal inscriptions–a permanent record of community thinking.

milestones.title: Version 0.77 public review
milestones.description: The current working draft–Desirable Properties of a Meta-Layer v0.77–is open for public review. Read and discuss chapters on book.desirableproperties.org (comments live). Patch draft text on Gov Hub.

milestones.title: Workgroup formation
milestones.description: Formation of workgroups for each Desirable Property–recruiting coordinators, co-leads, and contributors to steward individual chapters through the next phase.

milestones.title: Community review & patches
milestones.description: Discuss chapters on the book (comments live). Patch drafts on Gov Hub. Workgroups gather commentary, propose patches, and explore implementations that strengthen the coherence of the emerging framework.

milestones.title: Community Review Draft preparation
milestones.description: Workgroups integrate community feedback and editorial revisions to prepare the Community Review Draft of The Layered Web: Desirable Properties of a Meta-Layer (23 DPs) for the September 16 public milestone.

milestones.title: The Layered Web: Desirable Properties of a Meta-Layer – Community Review Draft and Governance Feedback Workflow
milestones.description: Join us for a public milestone marking the two-year anniversary of the Meta-Layer Initiative kickoff and Vint Cerf's challenge to define the desirable properties of a meta-layer. We will share the Community Review Draft of The Layered Web: Desirable Properties of a Meta-Layer, now organized around 23 Desirable Properties, and demonstrate the governance, patching, feedback, and update workflow that will guide the path toward Version 1.0.

milestones.title: Metaweb book 2nd edition
milestones.description: Publish the second edition of The Metaweb alongside the Version 1.0 Desirable Properties release, updating the foundational narrative for the post-launch Meta-Layer path.

milestones.title: Desirable Properties Version 1.0 release
milestones.description: Target release of Version 1.0 of The Layered Web: Desirable Properties of a Meta-Layer – the first mature community-developed edition, published with a permanent Ordinal edition as part of the Digital Monument.

milestones.title: Define ML-REQs
milestones.description: Turn Version 1.0 Desirable Properties into Meta-Layer requirements (ML-REQs) that can gate architecture, implementations, and partner integrations.

milestones.title: Canopi, communities, SDK, and web embed beta
milestones.description: Open a shared beta for Canopi, community layers, the Canopi SDK, and web embed so builders and site partners can ship overlay applications.

milestones.title: Proof of Unique Humanity integration
milestones.description: Integrate Proof of Unique Humanity so participation, accountability, and rewards can rest on unique-human verification rather than platform-owned identity.

milestones.title: Rewards for participants and builders
milestones.description: Stand up rewards for participants and builders who contribute to communities, implementations, and the public-good Meta-Layer stack.

milestones.title: Overweb sociotechnical contract
milestones.description: Publish the sociotechnical contract on the Requirements to be an Overweb application, aligning builders with ML-REQ expectations for interoperable overlay apps.

milestones.title: Develop ML-ADRs
milestones.description: Develop Meta-Layer Architecture Decision Records (ML-ADRs) that turn ML-REQs into concrete technical choices for the Overweb.

milestones.title: Overweb Substrate beta
milestones.description: Release an Overweb Substrate beta so implementations can run against a shared coordination layer rather than one-off overlays.

milestones.title: Extend federated auth to decentralized platforms
milestones.description: Extend federated authentication beyond today's web apps so decentralized platforms can participate in the same accountability frame.

milestones.title: Decentralized storage
milestones.description: Bring decentralized storage into the stack so community records and overlays are not locked to a single host.

milestones.title: Provenance of all posts
milestones.description: Require provenance for posts so origin, authorship, and context travel with content across layers.

milestones.title: MoltLayer raise
milestones.description: MoltLayer fundraising to resource the next build cycle for Overweb infrastructure and aligned products.

milestones.title: Desirable Properties book V2
milestones.description: Publish Version 2 of the Desirable Properties book, incorporating post-launch requirements, ADRs, and implementation learning.

milestones.title: Agents and TEEs
milestones.description: Advance agent capabilities with Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) so autonomous work can run with stronger integrity and accountability.

milestones.title: Community governance
milestones.description: Operationalize community governance so Meta-Layer rules, membership, and stewardship can evolve in the open.

milestones.title: Metadomains
milestones.description: Introduce metadomains as named, interoperable community spaces that sit above today's sites and platforms.

milestones.title: Publish The Overweb Book
milestones.description: Publish The Overweb Book as the narrative companion to the live coordination layer, substrate, and community practices built after Desirable Properties launch.
